children: Aurobindo Pharma shares will remain in focus on September 16 after the USFDA issued one observation following an inspection of an API manufacturing facility of its wholly owned subsidiary Apitoria Pharma in Gaddapotharam, Telangana.

The inspection was conducted from September 7 to September 15 and concluded with one procedural observation, the company said, adding that it will respond to the regulator within the stipulated timeline.

Separately, Aurobindo Pharma received final USFDA approval to manufacture and market Beclomethasone Dipropionate HFA Inhalation Aerosol, 40 mcg and 80 mcg, a generic equivalent of QVAR Inhalation Aerosol.
Catch all the market action on our live blog
Last week, the company’s step-down subsidiary A1 Biochem Labs (India) subscribed to 10,000 equity shares of A1 Biochem USA Inc. in the US, each with a face value of $100.
The company also received zero observations from the USFDA following an inspection of Apitoria Pharma’s API manufacturing facility in Andhra Pradesh from September 7 to September 11.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 1,664.90, down Rs 10.55, or 0.63 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 1,706.70 and a 52-week low of Rs 1,066.00 on 01 September, 2026 and 08 October, 2025, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 2.45 percent below its 52-week high and 56.18 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 96,697.66 crore.

title: Aurobindo Pharma shares in focus after USFDA issues one observation for Telangana facility
